cuts.reason: Cuts from the wide two-shot establishing the ICU waiting room to a tighter framing on both characters right as the deadpan 'Yeah.' lands, pushing in for the start of the real point of the joke.

Cuts to a closer, phone-in-frame composition right as the woman delivers 'Now it has to match a song,' emphasizing the punchline visually by tightening on the phones/reactions at the exact moment the joke lands.
Cuts to an extreme close-up on the woman's deadpan face during the post-punchline silence, holding on her blank reaction so the joke can breathe before the button.

Dissolves from the character's close-up reaction into the title/logo end-card, softening the transition out of the scene into the branded outro rather than cutting hard, since the joke has already resolved.

reaction_shots.description: Close-up on both characters' deadpan, unbothered faces glancing at phones right after the 'match a song' line, milking the joke's flat reaction.
Extended close-up on the woman's blank, half-lidded stare as the button/silence beat plays out before the outro.

pacing_notes: Shots start near average length (~2.6s) for the setup line, stretch to the longest shot of the video (~4.4s) to let 'we can't even be sad normally anymore' and the setup breathe, then compress to ~2.3s and ~2.2s as the punchline ('match a song') and its deadpan reaction land back to back, before settling into a final ~1.5s dissolve out to the logo card. The rhythm is slow-build into a quick one-two punch (punchline cut + reaction cut) followed by a soft dissolve exit, typical of a short setup/punch/hold/out structure.
